posts.title: Three Days in Boyd Station
posts.excerpt: A few days in Boyd Station, Kentucky, reveal a place shaped by meadows, repair work, porch light, and the easy patience of people who do not need to announce themselves.

posts.title: The Capitalist Contradiction
posts.excerpt: A look at how late capitalism repackages control as freedom, style, and self-invention.

posts.title: Player One
posts.excerpt: A memory of being handed a controller becomes an essay about pressure, control, and the simple moments that still cut through the noise.

posts.title: In the Shadow of Loss
posts.excerpt: After several deaths in quick succession, grief stopped arriving as a single event and became the atmosphere around everything else.
